source.raw_text:
Andrew Cunningham

• Ti-Cats 1H +3.5 (-115) / (4.6u) 
• Ti-Cats 1H ML (+140) / (1u) 

This game is a classic CFL rivalry. Hamilton is 3-0 in their last 3 matchups when they play on the road against the Argos dating back to 2024. This Ti-Cats team was the biggest threat in the CFL until their starting QB Bo Levi Mitchell went down, it’s been a rough patch since then but it seems like they have now got back in a groove. Keep in mind, Tre Ford will get the start tonight against the Argos; this is the same guy that took down Toronto as a +4.5 / +5.5 point dog at home! Now the books are pricing Hamilton as a +4.5 dog, on the road, with the same QB starting that beat the Argos in week 7; the books are saying this is basically a PK but we are catching points. 

I think Hamilton can have a field day against this Argos defense.
